facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 52°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Harts Pass (6,490 ft) 8 days later, Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft) 16 days earlier and Swamp Creek (3,930 ft) 5 days later than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 3 (2023), April 19 (2024), April 19 (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 13 (2024), April 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft), the second highest at Swamp Creek (3,930 ft) and the lowest at Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: 59.7 in on April 5; earlier seasons: 53.6 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 37.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: 0.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 13.6 in (2023), 6.4 in (2024), 10.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: 10.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 18.4 in (2023), 4.2 in (2024), 6.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 13 and June 18, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 1,024 ft above the pass; points to April 28 to June 25

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 1,006 ft below the pass; points to March 23 to May 20

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 1,536 ft below the pass; points to April 13 to June 18
